prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: one accurate Chinese relational overview of Pico's existing long-term-memory SQLite schema, for its engineering article.
Title exact: "Pico 长期记忆表关系"
Subtitle exact: "memory.sqlite · Schema v9 · 9 张业务表"

Visual style: match a clean light educational infographic: white background, charcoal readable sans-serif Chinese and monospace-like English table identifiers, sky-blue data cards, amber processing cards, green policy card, subtle grey external reference card. Landscape 3:2, high resolution, generous margins. Use large legible labels, no tiny footnotes, no decorative icons that compete with data. Exact English table names must be legible. Each table appears exactly ONCE. No vector tables, no embeddings, no invented database tables.

Composition: three clear columns.
LEFT column headed "记忆数据": 3 blue table cards stacked vertically.
A: "memory_items" with "PK item_id", "content / version", "scope_type / scope_key".
B: "memory_item_keys" with "PK (item_id, normalized_key)", "FK item_id".
C: "memory_item_sources" with "PK (item_id, event_id)", "FK item_id", "session_id / run_id / turn_id".
Draw exactly TWO solid blue database-FK connectors: parent memory_items -> child memory_item_keys, label "1 : N"; parent memory_items -> child memory_item_sources, label "1 : N". Parent-to-child connector labels should be visible and their routing must not cross text. Shared left-margin routing may be used for second edge. Solid edges connect only those true relations.

MIDDLE column headed "提取与提交": 5 amber table cards stacked vertically, ordered:
D: "memory_write_operations", "PK operation_id", "request_hash / result_json".
E: "memory_extraction_receipts", "PK / FK operation_id", "session_id / result_json".
F: "memory_extraction_cursors", "PK session_id", "processed_ordinal".
G: "memory_extraction_failures", "PK session_id", "first_operation_id: UNIQUE".
H: "memory_compaction_policy_denials", "PK (session_id, compaction_checkpoint_id)".
Draw ONE solid blue FK connector from D to E labelled "1 : 0..1". It must not imply all write operations have a receipt.
For logical shared identity, place a dashed AMBER vertical bus beside E,F,G,H with dashed stubs to these four cards; label bus "按 session_id 程序关联". This shared identity bus is not a workflow and not a FK. Connect card C (sources) to that shared identity bus with a dashed amber connector also identifying "session_id". Keep routes outside card text and no ambiguous solid lines.

RIGHT column headed "用户策略与外部来源".
I: one green card exact table name "memory_settings", fields "PK workspace_key", "enabled / auto_extract / recall_enabled", explanatory exact text "固定用户级键". This policy table has NO FK connector. Small label "策略由 Host 读取".
Below I, a light grey external box labeled "外部：工作区 pico.sqlite", second line "RuntimeEvent 原始事件", third line "不计入 9 张记忆表".
Connect memory_item_sources to this external box ONLY with a dashed amber connector labelled "来源回读 · 非跨库外键". No other source connector into policy table.

Prominent bottom legend with exact text:
"实线：数据库外键"
"虚线：程序关联与来源回读"
Footer exact text:
"3 条外键关系 · 附属记录 ON DELETE CASCADE"
Smaller but still readable final explanatory sentence exact:
"session_id 使用 [workspaceKey, sessionId] 内部会话键"

Constraints: the only actual database FK relationships are A->B, A->C, D->E. There must be exactly 9 memory table cards, plus one clearly external RuntimeEvent box. Never draw FK from settings to any memory table or FK between cursor/failure/denial tables. Distinguish UNIQUE from FK on first_operation_id. Avoid arrow crossings and preserve all exact identifiers. Think carefully about connectivity before drawing.
